# Pelikan Pens from Pure Pens

> UK specialist retailer of premium Pelikan writing instruments, offering fountain pens, ballpoint pens, rollerball pens, and mechanical pencils across the Souveran, Classic, Toledo, and Jazz collections.

Pure Pens has been a dedicated Pelikan pen specialist since 2004, curating a comprehensive range of luxury and mid-range writing instruments. The site serves collectors and everyday users seeking quality German-engineered pens with expert guidance on model selection.

## Key Topics

- Pelikan Souveran series
- Fountain pens
- Luxury writing instruments
- Pelikan Classic range
- Ballpoint pens
- Rollerball pens
- Mechanical pencils
- Premium nib options

- Souveran 400/405
- Niche pen retailer

## Pelikan Souveran Collections

- [Pelikan Souveran 1000 - EXTRA LARGE](https://www.pelikanpens.co.uk/collections/pelikan-souveran-1000-extra-large): Flagship Pelikan Souveran M1000 with gold trim and 18c nib for the ultimate luxury writing experience
- [Pelikan Souveran 800 & 805 - LARGE](https://www.pelikanpens.co.uk/collections/pelikan-souveran-800-805-large): Popular large-sized Souveran models with gold and silver trim options
- [Pelikan Souveran 600 & 605 - MEDIUM](https://www.pelikanpens.co.uk/collections/pelikan-souveran-600-605-medium): Mid-sized Souveran pens with 14c nib options for balanced writing comfort
- [Pelikan Souveran 400 & 405 - SMALL](https://www.pelikanpens.co.uk/collections/pelikan-souveran-400-405-small): Classic small Souveran pens in production since 1929, iconic design
- [Pelikan Souveran and Classic Pens Guide](https://www.pelikanpens.co.uk/pages/pelikan-souveran-pens): Comprehensive guide to Pelikan Souveran and Classic pen models and naming conventions

## Writing Instrument Types

- [All Fountain Pens](https://www.pelikanpens.co.uk/collections/all-fountain-pens): Complete Pelikan fountain pen collection including Classic and Souveran series with various nib sizes
- [All Ballpoint Pens](https://www.pelikanpens.co.uk/collections/all-ballpoint-pens): Full range of Pelikan ballpoint pens featuring Jazz and Souveran series options
- [All Rollerball Pens](https://www.pelikanpens.co.uk/collections/all-rollerball-pens): Pelikan rollerball pens including premium Souveran models for smooth writing
- [All Mechanical Pencils](https://www.pelikanpens.co.uk/collections/all-mechanical-pencils): Precision Pelikan mechanical pencils with 0.7mm lead options
